verdict.rationale: The Crawl API is a documented first-party capability that pulls data from multiple pages in a single request, which is a form of bulk operation across many items. A community comment on concurrency allowances suggests parallel sessions are supported, but no generic batch endpoint over arbitrary item lists is shown. Missing for 10: a documented batch scrape/extract over arbitrary URL or item lists, batch session or agent-task orchestration, and hands-on corroboration of bulk runs at scale.
